ozet:
A world where the existence of magic has been known for a century as a mysterious power to rival science. However, the discovery of MISO - the Material of an Impediment to the Sorcerer's Orders - made magic into not a special power, but a technique that can be raised. One morning, while Shouta Hacchouya (a high school boy attending a magic academy) was tasting miso soup, a princess of Majieeru suddenly breaks in. Majieeru happens to be the birthplace of magic.

(Source: Anime News Network)

bolumler.ad: Mahou Tsukai Nara Miso o Kue!
